target.question: Why did Lina cancel the community studio booking?
candidates: The available time conflicts with Lina’s schedule.

initial_events.raw_text: Lina reserved the community studio and later cancelled twice without stating a reason.
A staff member assumed that the fee might be the issue, but Lina did not confirm this.
The building manager reported a temporary lift outage to staff; there is no record that Lina received this report.

probes: Ask Lina what made the studio unusable for her.
Ask Lina whether the fee is too high.
Ask Lina whether a different time would work.

COST.ASK_OPEN: Lina says the fee is beyond her budget.
COST.ASK_FEE: Lina says yes, the fee is too high.
COST.ASK_TIME: Lina says another time would not solve the price.

SCHEDULE.ASK_OPEN: Lina says the booked hour conflicts with a required appointment.
SCHEDULE.ASK_FEE: Lina says the fee is fine.
SCHEDULE.ASK_TIME: Lina says an evening slot would work.

OTHER_UNKNOWN.ASK_OPEN: Lina says she cannot reach the upstairs room while the lift is out.
OTHER_UNKNOWN.ASK_FEE: Lina says the fee is fine; access is the problem.
OTHER_UNKNOWN.ASK_TIME: Lina says another time would help only after access is restored.

actions: Confirm an accessible room or restored lift before rebooking.

target.question: Why has Omar not begun the training practice?
candidates: Omar lacks an uninterrupted practice window.

initial_events.raw_text: Omar enrolled in a skills session and received the practice instructions.
Omar attended the demonstration but has not started the optional exercise.
A teammate guessed Omar was too busy; Omar has not endorsed that explanation.

probes: Ask whether a reserved practice hour would allow a start.
Ask what would make the first practice attempt feel safe.
Ask Omar what is blocking the first attempt.

TIME.ASK_WINDOW: Omar says a protected hour would let him begin.
TIME.ASK_READINESS: Omar says he understands the task but needs time.
TIME.ASK_OPEN: Omar says his current shift leaves no uninterrupted practice window.

CONFIDENCE.ASK_WINDOW: Omar says time is available but he is not sure whether mistakes are safe.
CONFIDENCE.ASK_READINESS: Omar says a supervised first attempt would help because he fears practicing incorrectly.
CONFIDENCE.ASK_OPEN: Omar says he has time but is uncertain about doing it correctly.

OTHER_UNKNOWN.ASK_WINDOW: Omar says extra time will not help because the practice account is disabled.
OTHER_UNKNOWN.ASK_READINESS: Omar says he cannot access the exercise at all.
OTHER_UNKNOWN.ASK_OPEN: Omar says the practice account is disabled.

actions: Offer a low-stakes supervised first attempt.
Restore the practice account before planning practice.

target.question: Why has Mira paused the translation review?

initial_events.raw_text: Mira accepted a translation review and received the text document.
Mira asked whether a glossary was available; the coordinator sent one.
The coordinator later found that an audio attachment in the shared manifest pointed to a missing file. This discovery was not sent to Mira.
Another reviewer guessed the deadline was too short, without asking Mira.

probes: Ask Mira whether any required source material is unavailable.
Ask whether the glossary is sufficient.
Ask whether a longer deadline would solve the pause.

TERMS.ASK_INPUT: Mira says she needs a specialized term list not in the glossary.
TERMS.ASK_TERMS: Mira says the glossary lacks the relevant technical terms.
TERMS.ASK_TIME: Mira says the deadline is adequate if the terminology is clarified.

DEADLINE.ASK_INPUT: Mira says all material is available but she cannot finish by the deadline.
DEADLINE.ASK_TERMS: Mira says the glossary is sufficient.
DEADLINE.ASK_TIME: Mira says two more days would solve the problem.

OTHER_UNKNOWN.ASK_INPUT: Mira says the required audio cannot be opened from the shared link.
OTHER_UNKNOWN.ASK_TERMS: Mira says the terms are clear but she cannot access the audio.
OTHER_UNKNOWN.ASK_TIME: Mira says more time alone will not restore the missing audio.

actions: Agree on a longer review deadline.
Restore the source audio before asking Mira to continue.

target.question: Why did Theo miss the seed exchange?
candidates: Theo could not get to the venue.
Theo no longer wants to participate.

initial_events.raw_text: Theo had asked for two seed varieties before the exchange.
Theo did not arrive during the scheduled exchange.
The organizer saw a bus service notice but has no evidence Theo saw it.

probes: Ask Theo whether travel to the venue was possible.
Ask whether Theo still wants the seeds.

TRANSPORT.ASK_TRAVEL: Theo says the last bus was cancelled and he had no ride.
TRANSPORT.ASK_INTEREST: Theo says he still wants to take part.
TRANSPORT.ASK_OPEN: Theo says he could not reach the venue after the bus cancellation.

INTEREST.ASK_INTEREST: Theo says he no longer wants the seeds.
INTEREST.ASK_OPEN: Theo says he changed his mind about joining.

OTHER_UNKNOWN.ASK_TRAVEL: Theo says travel was possible but the event notice gave the wrong room.
OTHER_UNKNOWN.ASK_INTEREST: Theo says he still wants the seeds.
OTHER_UNKNOWN.ASK_OPEN: Theo says he went to a different room because the notice was wrong.

actions: Offer a practical travel or pickup option.
Respect Theo’s stated decision not to participate.
Correct the event location and offer another handoff.

target.question: Why did Nadia decline the public notice photo?
candidates: Nadia does not want her image posted publicly.
Nadia cannot understand the notice text.

initial_events.raw_text: Nadia agreed to share event details but declined the proposed public photograph.
The organizer offered to translate the notice; Nadia said the written wording was clear.
A volunteer speculated that Nadia disliked the event, but Nadia did not say this.

probes: Ask whether a notice without Nadia’s image is acceptable.
Ask whether translated wording would change her decision.
Ask what condition would make the notice acceptable.

PRIVACY.ASK_PRIVACY: Nadia says yes, details without her image may be posted.
PRIVACY.ASK_LANGUAGE: Nadia says translation is not the concern.
PRIVACY.ASK_OPEN: Nadia says she wants to participate without a public photograph.

LANGUAGE.ASK_PRIVACY: Nadia says a photo alone is not the central issue.
LANGUAGE.ASK_LANGUAGE: Nadia says she needs the notice in another language before approving it.
LANGUAGE.ASK_OPEN: Nadia says she cannot approve text she cannot read.

OTHER_UNKNOWN.ASK_PRIVACY: Nadia says the draft includes an outdated date and must be corrected first.
OTHER_UNKNOWN.ASK_LANGUAGE: Nadia says she understands the text but the date is wrong.
OTHER_UNKNOWN.ASK_OPEN: Nadia says the event date is incorrect.

actions: Publish only event details without Nadia’s image.
Provide translated notice text for review.
Correct the event date before requesting approval.

target.question: Why has Ravi not confirmed the equipment loan?
candidates: The equipment needs repair before lending.

initial_events.raw_text: Ravi requested the equipment for a weekend workshop.
A custodian said the equipment was physically working when last checked.
The office later corrected an old policy summary: this equipment now requires a separate authorization before any loan. Ravi did not receive the correction.
Another volunteer repeated the older policy summary, but this retelling has the same source.

probes: Ask Ravi whether the required loan authorization has been obtained.
Ask whether Ravi found a physical defect.
Ask whether the deposit prevents confirmation.

MAINTENANCE.ASK_APPROVAL: Ravi says he has approval but the equipment failed his own check.
MAINTENANCE.ASK_CONDITION: Ravi says the power connector failed during his check.
MAINTENANCE.ASK_DEPOSIT: Ravi says the deposit is affordable.

BUDGET.ASK_APPROVAL: Ravi says approval is available but the deposit exceeds his budget.
BUDGET.ASK_CONDITION: Ravi says the equipment appears to work.
BUDGET.ASK_DEPOSIT: Ravi says he cannot cover the deposit.

OTHER_UNKNOWN.ASK_APPROVAL: Ravi says he has not been told about the new authorization and has no approval yet.
OTHER_UNKNOWN.ASK_CONDITION: Ravi says the equipment appears to work.
OTHER_UNKNOWN.ASK_DEPOSIT: Ravi says the deposit is affordable but he has no approval.

actions: Repair and verify the equipment before lending.
Explain the current authorization requirement and obtain approval before lending.
